records: Correction: Circle's Q2 2026 19.5% daily weighted-average USDC-on-platform share and USD12.442B end balance are Circle's own platform metrics, not Coinbase's. Circle defines its platform to include Circle Mint accounts, corporate-held USDC and Circle-provided non-custodial wallets; the metric is used to calculate Circle's share of reserve income under the Collaboration Agreement. Coinbase's Q3 USD22B average USDC held in eligible Coinbase products and USD8.616B September 30 AOP USDC are separate measures with different scopes and time bases. Circle's USD655.3M H1 and USD324.6M Q2 distribution costs under Coinbase agreements do not disclose Coinbase's numeric share of average USDC on-platform balances. Prior graph/snapshot preserved; corrected addendum supersedes only the misattributed observation.
